scenarios.title: Continuous Jab to Cross chain
scenarios.before: Each completed strike briefly returns the whole body to Jog before the next punch owns the torso.
scenarios.after: Jab recovery feeds Cross anticipation directly while the authored Jog phase continues underneath.

scenarios.title: Move start during an active strike
scenarios.before: A standing punch keeps planted feet after movement begins, so the collider travels under a stationary pose.
scenarios.after: The same upper-punch phase hands its lower body to a phase-matched Jog on the movement-input frame.

scenarios.title: SIDE to UP-SIDE retarget while held
scenarios.before: The old sideways strike finishes against the previous tile before the new diagonal family can begin.
scenarios.after: A neutral recovery phase redirects into the closest diagonal Jog phase without resetting the feet.

scenarios.title: Opposite-side mining reversal
scenarios.before: The active punch remains aimed right after left input, then mirrors abruptly when the next strike starts.
scenarios.after: Facing changes immediately through the existing two planted Jog phases before the mirrored Cross continues.

scenarios.title: Travel-speed-matched mining feet
scenarios.shortTitle: No slow or fast foot skate
scenarios.before: The composite advances the same fourteen Jog phases whether the player travels slowly or at full run speed.
scenarios.after: Only the lower-body Jog sampling follows resolved travel distance; punch timing and contact remain unchanged.
